hard_rule: INTEGRATE BEFORE IMPLEMENT → ADAPT BEFORE REWRITE → CUSTOM-BUILD ONLY WHERE EDEN ADDS UNIQUE VALUE. Keep the proven machinery. Replace or adapt the experience. Integrate it until it feels like one system.

integration_tiers.0_run: Existing software runs unchanged where appropriate.
integration_tiers.1_present: edenOS supplies launcher, identity, window presentation and file associations.
integration_tiers.2_integrate: Add system search, preview, commands, notifications, sharing, permissions and settings integration.
integration_tiers.3_native_experience: Keep mature engine/provider underneath; edenOS supplies the complete user-facing experience.

rule: Do not wrap or rename a mature standard unless an EDEN integration requirement justifies it.
